interface.signature: int a, int b, int c -> str

preconditions.description: a, b, and c are non-negative integers within the range [0, 100].
At least one of a, b, or c is greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: all('aaa' not in s and 'bbb' not in s and 'ccc' not in s for s in [stdout])
postconditions.description: The returned string s does not contain any of the substrings 'aaa', 'bbb', or 'ccc'.

postconditions.expression: s.count('a') <= a and s.count('b') <= b and s.count('c') <= c
postconditions.description: The returned string s contains at most a 'a's, at most b 'b's, and at most c 'c's.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= len(t) for t in [stdout] if (t.count('a') <= a and t.count('b') <= b and t.count('c') <= c and all('aaa' not in t and 'bbb' not in t and 'ccc' not in t for _ in [t])))
postconditions.description: The returned string s is the longest possible string satisfying the constraints, or the empty string if no such string exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if (a == 0 and b == 0 and c == 0) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid string can be formed (i.e., a = b = c = 0), the returned string is the empty string.
